claims.text: The theorem a² + b² = c² for right-angled triangles is named after Pythagoras.
The theorem is not named after Euclid, Archimedes or Thales.
Babylonian clay tablets from around 1800 BC, such as Plimpton 322, show that the relationship was known.
Around 1800 BC is more than 1,000 years before around 570 BC.
